stage: Stage 8 - Global Ridge Regression & Recursive Multi-Step Forecasting
question: Can a fixed global Ridge model outperform the 28-day historical mean under origin-safe recursive validation?

model_configuration.project_stage: Stage 8 - Global Ridge Regression & Recursive Multi-Step Forecasting

preprocessing.fit_scope: fit independently on each fold's training rows only

training_policy.architecture: one global model per validation fold across all 300 item-store series

forecast_policy.history: actual active demand through forecast origin, followed only by prior clipped predictions

model_configuration.price_policy: all price and price-history features excluded
model_configuration.intermittency_history_feature_policy: zero rates and days-since-last-positive excluded from Ridge v1

results.fold_stability_statement: Ridge's MAE improvement was not consistent across all three folds, so time-period sensitivity is an important warning.
results.balanced_conclusion: Ridge did not establish a balanced, consistent improvement over the 28-day mean. Its results remain useful as the first global linear-model benchmark.
results.stage9_recommendation: The next reviewed experiment may consider one controlled nonlinear global model because Ridge's additive linear assumptions did not dominate the simple baseline.
